---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case

Describe the problem or use case this feature would solve.

**Example scenario:**
"As a penetration tester, I need [X] so that I can [Y]"

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## Implementation Notes

If you have technical suggestions, add them here:

- [ ] Backend API changes needed
- [ ] Worker/browser changes needed
- [ ] Database schema changes
- [ ] New dependencies required

## Ethical & Security Considerations

**IMPORTANT:** All features must align with authorized testing principles.

- [ ] This feature requires consent-as-code validation
- [ ] This feature includes human-in-the-loop approval
- [ ] This feature does NOT enable unauthorized testing
- [ ] This feature does NOT implement attack evasion
- [ ] Audit logging is included

## Priority

- [ ] Critical (blocks work)
- [ ] High (important for MVP)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] Low (future enhancement)

## Additional Context

Screenshots, mockups, references, or other context.
